a_0.note: Checked against the freshly mined TRAIN tables by LoopConfig.assert_a_0, called from rails.evolution_carrier every time the loop loads carrier material, so the pin is executed rather than transcribed. content_hash is the floored schema KC-S1b flew byte for byte (60 intents, 261 type rows over 52 types, 1,008 fillers); unfloored_content_hash is the min_share 0.0 mining (60 intents, 432 type rows over 55 types, 1,281 fillers), which nothing pinned before the closure row and which is the SOLE authority for every count, every share and every intent's 1 + L line cap -- i.e. for everything a candidate cannot write.

decontamination.a0_exemption: A_0's 1,008 TRAIN fillers carry 8 distinct 6-gram digests, of which 1 occurs in the DEV-1000 digest set and is therefore exempt. A_0 itself PASSES the gate; a filler shorter than six words yields no 6-gram at all, which is why 1,008 fillers produce 8 grams
decontamination.baseline_filler_texts: A_0's own 1,008 TRAIN fillers, which KC-S1b already sent and which are therefore exempt: refusing them would refuse the incumbent itself
decontamination.evaluation_ngram_digests: the committed artifact above, read through rails.proposer.load_evaluation_ngram_digests: 2,205 sha256 digests of the DEV-1000 sentence 6-grams (NEW500 contributes 1,133 of them, a strict subset). This is the route a FLIGHT takes. SAEA-SLURP-MF-EVO-DECONTAMINATION-V1 is the one row licensed to open SLURP devel sentence text and it has already spent that licence; a per-round candidate validation consumes its hash-pinned product instead, so no devel text is opened, held, rendered or logged a second time, and a refusal names digests
decontamination.evaluation_sentence_texts: the raw-sentence route, kept for the registered model-free row and for tests. A flight passes evaluation_ngram_digests instead; the two routes are unioned by rails.proposer.validate_slurp_candidate_artifact and decide identically, which tests/unit/test_slurp_proposer_family.py asserts
decontamination.exemplar_texts: the construction rows each candidate's proposer was shown; overlap is measured and reported, never gated

note: The EVO-S1 loop, as data. scripts/run_evolution_round.py carries no cell knowledge of its own; every value here is preregistered in docs/readiness/2026-09-06-slurp-evo-s1-slot-schema-evolution-v1-preregistration.md, which is REGISTERED as of 2026-09-06. The one-time closed-list intent flight SAEA-SLURP-EVO-S1-INTENT-FOLDS-V2 has SEALED on both folds (2026-09-06) and fold_predecessors now carries their two manifest sha256s, so nothing blocks a round. Everything model-free is closed: a_0 is pinned and re-derived at every carrier load, the decontamination artifact is built and A_0 passes it, and all seven exposure rows are registered and proved to admit the loop's worst case. targets are the eighteen SCENARIOS, one stratum member each (target_kind scenario); artifact_keys are the sixty INTENTS those scenarios own, in descending TRAIN mention mass, which is the order the proposer is shown the blocks in and therefore the order it must return them in. The two controls are deterministic (deterministic_placebo), so a round costs 54 proposer contacts and not 90, and the round-1 form twin needs a token counter bound to the resident server's /tokenize. Both harm rules are RATES at harms_per_rows 30 (owner, 2026-09-06): on the V2 draw's 60 rows per scenario stage one admits a candidate with at most 2 harms and stage two tolerates harms - saves <= 2, which is what makes the preregistered gate reachable for EIGHT of eighteen scenarios instead of three at 30 rows; EVO-A1's 20-row tool quotas keep reading 1 without declaring the field. base_fragment is the projected template the candidate fragments are copied from and is never flown directly; the incumbent flies its per-fold variant, which LoopConfig.incumbent_fragment names. The proposer half declares its own model fragment (proposer_model_fragment): the reward cells are KC-S1b's arm at max_tokens 64 and a proposer contact returns a scenario's whole block set at the preregistered ceiling of 1536, and decoding_params lives in the model fragment, which core.config.compose refuses to take from two fragments at once. EVO-A1 declares the field not at all and both its halves keep flying one fragment, byte for byte unchanged. split_ids names the three populations' split_id values, which are the rosters' own split_name strings: core.flight.FlightRuntime._prepare reads values['split_id'] off the COMPOSED config and no emitted fragment carried one, so every fragment this loop wrote was unflyable until the field existed. EVO-A1 declares it not at all and its fragments stay byte for byte what they were. scorer_id is the TRAIN binding of the official scorer, because every fold row is a construction-role discovery utterance drawn from train.jsonl and the devel-bound id refuses them outright; it is the same evaluate.py at the same pinned commit, and it is the id the fold arms declare, so analysis.paired.per_sample_scores_from_score_file finds its rows.
